findings.title: Distinct import identities can generate the same transaction ID

evidence.detail: The ID is raw colon-delimited account_id, source, and external_id values, although each may itself contain colons.

findings.impact: Two valid identities can generate the same primary key, permanently preventing one import.
findings.remediation: Use unambiguous length-prefixed or escaped encoding.

findings.title: Business preconditions are checked outside their write transactions

evidence.detail: edit_transaction checks the fetched version before entering its write transaction.
The subsequent UPDATE is unconditional by transaction_id.
Reconciliation selects and totals candidates before its transaction begins.

findings.impact: Concurrent instances can overwrite newer data or reconcile a set different from the checked amount.
findings.remediation: Begin transitions before reading preconditions and use conditional writes.

findings.title: Storage failures escape the required stable error model

evidence.detail: import_csv translates only sqlite3.IntegrityError.
reconcile performs database reads without SQLite exception translation.

findings.impact: Operational failures can escape without stable code or operation_id.
findings.remediation: Translate sqlite3.Error at every public mutation boundary.

findings.title: CSV imports have no resource bounds

evidence.detail: The parser accepts the entire csv_text without size limits.
Every parsed row is retained in memory.

findings.impact: A large import can exhaust memory or CPU.
findings.remediation: Enforce byte, row, and field limits.

findings.title: Money validation accepts integers SQLite cannot store or sum

evidence.detail: _require_money accepts every Python int without a persistence-range check.
Balances use SQLite SUM, which can overflow.

findings.impact: Valid contract integers can fail with raw implementation exceptions.
findings.remediation: Preserve arbitrary precision or define and enforce a range.

report.security_posture: Bound SQL and no credential/network surface; unbounded CSV permits local denial of service.
report.strongest_quality: State changes and audit events are generally colocated in one SQLite transaction.
report.weakest_quality: Concurrency invariants rely on stale reads followed by unconditional writes.

Lifecycle tests omit concurrency and operational failures.
No lifecycle, recovery, or concurrency policy is exposed.
Transaction behavior is unsafe for multiple instances.
